summary: Copy semantic TUI card content without borders, alignment padding or soft wraps; copy tables as TSV

replay.detail: Rendering and interaction only; no replay.

schema.detail: No client-v0 schema or generated client changes.

rules.detail: No authoring or runtime policy changes.

compatibility.detail: Plain drag remains app-owned and copies semantic text on release. Outside inputs, conversation typing and existing answer shortcuts, y copies the focused card body. Copy text in the context menu copies the pointed block. Full-width card actions activate on release so dragging does not activate them. Card frames remain unchanged.

manual.detail: Clipboard copy requests use OSC 52 and require terminal clipboard permission; tmux requires clipboard forwarding configuration. Feedback reports a written request, not unobservable clipboard acceptance. Native cell selection remains available through the terminal's mouse-selection override.

recovery.detail: Revert the rendering and interaction change; no stored data changes.
